CVE-2024-39331.title: In Emacs before 29.4, org-link-expand-abbrev in lisp/ol.el expand ...
CVE-2024-39331.description: In Emacs before 29.4, org-link-expand-abbrev in lisp/ol.el expands a %(...) link abbrev even when it specifies an unsafe function, such as shell-command-to-string. This affects Org Mode before 9.7.5.
